notes.title: New Tiny Teams Demo!!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45015938/242c9b128e353b300ecef14d40c76e4b0056c1ad.png"][/img][/p][p]As we gear up for the full release of Backpack Boy we have a brand new demo for everyone to try!

This new demo includes over 30 new screens/levels as well as a ton of visual improvements and fixes.
[/p][p]This has taken quite a while to put together so I hope you all enjoy![/p][p]- Chuck and Niles[/p]
